title: Slow-cooker beef and onion casserole
subtitle: A plain, deeply satisfying British braised beef
excerpt: Braising steak cooked slowly with onion, carrot, and beef stock into a thick, glossy gravy. Classic British comfort food that needs bread or mash alongside.
sourceNotes: Beef and onion casserole is a staple of British home cooking with roots in wartime economy cooking. The method of slow-braising cheap cuts in a covered pot with stock and vegetables is common to many British cookbooks of the mid-20th century.

recipe.freezeNotes: Freeze in portions for up to 3 months. Defrost overnight in the fridge and reheat gently.
recipe.makeAheadNotes: Better the next day. Refrigerate overnight and reheat gently on the hob.

content.text: This is the sort of recipe that does not need explaining. Beef, onion, stock, and time. The gravy thickens as the collagen from the braising steak dissolves. It becomes rich and glossy without any thickening agent needed. The onion turns very sweet after a long cook.
Browning the beef before it goes in makes the gravy darker and richer. It is worth the extra 10 minutes. If you are pressed for time, skip it; the casserole will still taste good but will be paler.
Serve with mashed potato, bread, or boiled potatoes. A handful of fresh parsley at the end brightens the colour.
Heat a frying pan over high heat. In batches, brown {{braising-steak}} of beef chunks on all sides until a dark crust forms. Transfer to the slow cooker.

Add {{onion}} sliced onions, {{carrot}} of carrot chunks, and {{garlic}} of crushed garlic to the slow cooker. Stir in {{tomato-puree}} of tomato puree and {{worcestershire-sauce}} of Worcestershire sauce. Pour over {{stock-beef}} of beef stock. Add {{thyme}} of thyme sprigs and {{bay-leaves}} of bay. Season with {{sea-salt-fine}} of salt.
Set the slow cooker to LOW and cook for 7 to 8 hours. The beef should be very tender. Discard the thyme and bay. Taste and adjust seasoning before serving.

rows.cause: The beef released a lot of liquid and the stock diluted it further.
rows.fix: Mix a tablespoon of cornflour with 2 tablespoons of cold water and stir into the pot. Set to HIGH for 15 minutes until thickened. Or reduce the liquid in a pan separately.

rows.symptom: The beef is not fully tender after 8 hours
rows.cause: Very thick chunks, older beef, or a slow cooker that runs cooler than average.
rows.fix: Switch to HIGH for a further hour. Braising steak always gets there eventually; it may just need more time.

rows.cause: The stock was weak, or the beef was not browned before cooking.
rows.fix: Add another teaspoon of Worcestershire sauce and a tablespoon of tomato puree. Stir and cook on HIGH for 15 more minutes.

rows.cause: Carrot cooked for 8 hours will become very soft.
rows.fix: Stir the soft carrot through the gravy; it will thicken it slightly. Next time add the carrots in the last 2 to 3 hours.

content.text: Beef casserole is one of the most enduring dishes in British home cooking. It is a method rather than a recipe: tough, cheap cuts braised in liquid until they are better than expensive ones. The slow cooker is an excellent match for this principle. It does exactly what a covered pot in a low oven does, but with less energy and no need to check.
